title: Pagasa: Shear line, three weather systems to bring rains on Saturday

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The persisting shear line will bring heavy rains over the eastern sections of northern and Central Luzon, while three other weather systems will affect parts of the country on Saturday, Nov. 21, according to the weather bureau. In its 5 a.m. weather forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) reported that cloudy skies with scattered rains may prevail over mainland Cagayan, Isabela, Nueva Vizcaya, Quirino, Aurora, and Quezon due to the shear line.
